# Lemo-Opuscar Film Styles Catalogue

Complete reference of the 66 ready-to-use film styles in Lemo-Opuscar.
Each style contains a full artistic direction and code implementation guide in `$LIB/styles/<folder>/STYLE.md`.
Query or search styles directly using `python3 -B scripts/style_lookup.py`.

# Style index · 风格索引

Users may name a style in English, in Chinese, or by its folder. Find it here, then read `$LIB/styles/<folder>/STYLE.md`.
用户可能用英文名、中文名或文件夹名来指定风格。在这里查到文件夹，再读 `$LIB/styles/<文件夹>/STYLE.md`。
<!-- generated by styleboard/build.py from styles/*/style.json; do not edit by hand -->
